# Tickrate

> Tickrate is an iPhone app that tells you how many seconds a day your mechanical watch gains or loses. It compares the watch with atomic time a few hours or days apart for its true daily rate, and it can listen to the ticking through the iPhone's microphone for a quick estimate, always shown as a range. One watch is free, with unlimited checks and listens; its history shows the last 30 days. Tickrate Unlimited, a one-time purchase (US$7.99 in the United States), adds every watch, the full history, export and import.

Tickrate measures only the rate (seconds a day gained or lost), not amplitude or beat error. Listening gives an estimate as a range and gives no number when its two methods disagree; atomic time checks over a day or more give the true daily rate. Sound is analysed on the iPhone and never recorded or uploaded. iPhone only, iOS 17 or later.
